title: Knowledge
description: Connect a separate source to browse, search and import editable manuscripts.
libraryRequired: Connect a writable manuscript library before linking a read-only knowledge source.
unboundDescription: Originals stay in their directory; the index is stored in the manuscript library.
invalid: The knowledge binding is invalid. Reconnect it.
indexMissing: This library has no knowledge index. Start a scan explicitly.
indexEmpty: The current index contains no Markdown documents.
indexPartial: Some files or relationships are incomplete. Review diagnostics.
searchPlaceholder: Search full text in the saved index
resultsTruncated: Showing the first {{count}} results. Narrow the query.
noMatches: No matches in the current index.
previewLong: Long documents use source view to keep reading responsive.
selectDocument: Select a document to read its original
readNotice: Read only here. Import a manuscript to edit it.
sourceChanged: The original, index or reading snapshot differs. Reopen the document or scan to review the change.
contentTruncated: This file exceeds 2 MiB. Only a preview is shown; download the original for the full content.
forceDescription: Read the knowledge documents again to repair changes metadata cannot detect or corrupt shards. Originals remain read only; the previous index stays until the new one is complete.
unsupportedLink: This link cannot be read within the knowledge source.
missingLink: The target document is absent from the index. Scan and retry.
remoteImage: Remote or invalid image not loaded automatically: {{name}}

diagnostic.front-matter: Front matter could not be parsed
diagnostic.oversized: Document exceeds the 2 MiB index limit

searchUnavailable: Search did not complete. Review the message above.

graph.canvas: Knowledge graph; arrow keys pan, +/- zoom and 0 resets
graph.empty: No visible nodes in this scope.
graph.truncated: The view is capped or indexed relationships reached their limit. Filter or use a local graph.
graph.help: Drag the canvas to pan and use the wheel to zoom. Drag nodes; double-click or press Enter to open a read-only document.
graph.localOnly: Relationship depth is available in local graphs

citationHelp: Entries are freely editable text. Source fields are optional. Choose an existing entry to reuse its number.
citationQuote: Insert as a block quote (plain text by default)
citationLegacy: Insert at the manuscript caret or end of its selection. Select a legacy marker and explicitly check the replacement option to adopt it; other handwritten references and footnotes stay unmanaged.
citationTidyHelp: Reorder citation numbers and remove unused entries.
citationInsertFailed: The body changed or the editor is unavailable. Nothing was inserted; reopen and try again.
citationInvalid: The managed reference region is malformed. Check its markers at the end of the manuscript; source is unchanged.
topicNotePlaceholder: Record the topic's direction, questions or research plan…
topicTransfer: Move or copy to another shelf
topicNoOther: Create another topic in this knowledge source first
topicNoteHelp: Notes save separately; captured text and the original document stay unchanged.
topicUnsavedNote: The note has unsaved changes. Continue editing, discard or save before leaving.
topicRemoveHelp: Remove only this capture from the current topic. The source document and copies in other topics are retained.
topicDragHelp: Drag to reorder. With the keyboard, press Space to pick up, arrows to move, Enter to drop or Escape to cancel.
topicManualOnly: Switch to manual order to drag
topicCollectHelp: In the reader, use Collect to topic to save a document or passage. The text stays as captured.
researchInvalid: Invalid or oversized research data. The existing file was retained; inspect the library research file.
researchChanged: The library, source or research data changed. Nothing was overwritten; reload first.
citationTrackingFailed: The manuscript citation was inserted, but its source snapshot could not be saved: {{cause}}. Retain the body and collect the source again.
relationsEmpty: No document links. Only relationships already present in the original text appear here.
changesHelp: Checks local originals. Updating changes only the retained snapshot; you decide how to edit the manuscript.
changesEmpty: Collect material or insert a citation to review source changes here.
changeLocationHelp: Changed text may have moved. Review the current passage and adjust its line range if needed before updating the snapshot.
diffTruncated: Showing the first 1,000 diff rows. Read the complete original in the reader.
citationAfterSave: Source snapshots for this new draft will be recorded after its first save.
citationAdoptLegacy: Replace the selected legacy marker with this citation
replaceDescription: Locate the original directory to keep topics and citation origins. Changing the source creates a new identity; old auxiliary data stays in the library but is not shown under the new source. Continue to choose another directory?
pageDescription: Choose a read-only source to find documents, organize collections and review references.
partitionDescription: Up to 48 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. This changes only the local partition, never the original source directory.
sourceEditDescription: The name identifies this source. The directory organizes its local index, collections and reference records.
removeSourceDescription: Remove this connection. Original files, captured passages and manuscript references are retained.
chooseSource: Choose a source to browse documents
